candidateIdentity.variantName: Black Bay 54 37mm steel case, steel bracelet

sourceChecks.note: The exact official page independently validates reference M79000N-0001, the 37 mm steel case and three-link steel-bracelet configuration, a current PLN 19,450 Poland-localized offer, 11.2 mm thickness, 20 mm lug width, MT5400 automatic movement, approximately 70 hours of reserve, 200 m water resistance, screw-down crown, domed sapphire crystal, and T-fit clasp. TUDOR sends buyers to its official-retailer network, but does not publish exact inventory, lug-to-lug length, full weight, or the bracelet-to-case interface.

TUDOR's current Black Bay 54 family page corroborates the time-only MT5400, 70-hour reserve, 200 m rating, steel bracelet, rapid-adjust T-fit clasp, and a -2/+4-second fully assembled-watch tolerance. The family page also identifies TUDOR Official Retailers as the sales channel.

The official Black Bay 54 press dossier independently corroborates the exact black-dial steel-bracelet configuration, MT5400 rate bounds and daily-rate context, 70-hour reserve, Grade A Swiss Super-LumiNova, T-fit clasp, and absence of a date display.

The 1916 Company's exact-reference specialist review measures M79000N-0001 at 45.8 mm lug-to-lug. Its independently measured 11.2 mm thickness matches TUDOR's primary specification, and a separate hands-on source rounds the same span to 46 mm.
This separate hands-on Black Bay 54 review reports a 46 mm lug-to-lug span, corroborating the specialist's more precise 45.8 mm measurement after normal rounding.

The exact-reference new-watch listing reports 139 g with a 21 cm bracelet, but separate owner measurements report 135 g on a sized bracelet. Because link count changes configured weight, no normalized full-weight value is accepted from these snapshots.

This six-month exact-model owner review reports 135 g on its bracelet, conflicting with the exact-reference new-watch listing's 139 g at 21 cm. The difference is consistent with bracelet sizing, but the catalogue cannot normalize a full configured weight from differently sized examples.

The exact-reference fitment guide uses spring bars when fitting replacement straps, but TUDOR's exact product and service material does not independently document the factory bracelet mechanism. The project's physical-interface policy therefore keeps attachmentType open.
